first_observed_divergence: Native executes code/update.lua ready callback during OnCommand, including ScreenManager.GetTopScreen and GetNumChildren; owned session proceeds to core/main.lua SetUpdateFunction without that ready callback.

actual_source_contract.code/update.lua:4-26: Chunk returns the update function and a second ready callback.
actual_source_contract.default.lua:23-28: Custom environment loadfile forwards all chunk return values.
actual_source_contract.core/main.lua:43: All ready functions execute before SetUpdateFunction.

owned_cause: lua_util.rs load_script_file_with_source wraps the loaded function with inner.call::<Value>, discarding secondary return values; root executors may still intentionally request one actor value.
proposed_next_fix: Forward MultiValue from the scoped loaded chunk, preserving script directory, path and environment scopes. Add a regression for a secondary ready function plus nil positions and varargs before a retained-capture first repair.
